route_flags.description: Confidence in this route, not danger in the request: STRICT_WORKFLOW_ROUTE when the chosen workflow is itself STRICT, AMBIGUOUS_ROUTE when a competing workflow scored close.

deny_language.description: Phrases from the DENY doctrine class - a control waived, switched off, or overridden despite its verdict, or secrets to be disclosed - found in the objective, as CATEGORY:phrase. Evidence, not a verdict: it authorises nothing, and an empty array means these exact phrases were not found, not that nothing was demanded - a paraphrase walks past it. It reports presence, not intent, and judges neither polarity nor grammar beyond requiring the phrase to lie inside one sentence: a defensive sentence, or a phrase inside a longer noun, is reported too. Two filters that tried to be cleverer were withdrawn for silently dropping real demands. Optional, so RouteDecisions produced before it existed stay valid.

agent_discretion.description: True when the matched rule explicitly allows the agent to exercise semantic discretion to select or adjust the workflow (e.g. non-STRICT workflows). False or omitted for STRICT workflows where safety invariants prohibit downgrade.
